cand.title: OENOVITI International Symposium & General Assembly 2027
cand.excerpt: High evidence and geographic fit outrank generic Geneva demand; incumbent venue/accessibility is penalized where applicable.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Agathe Lairy, Université de Bordeaux / ISVV project manager, is a relevant operational approach: listed by the university foundation for OENOVITI enquiries and in the official 2026 network event-team contacts. Pierre-Louis Teissedre, Professor and OENOVITI coordinator/head, is a relevant senior sponsor and referral route. Marie Arduin is also named in the 2026 network event-team contacts. None is publicly verified as the 2027 hotel contracting authority; participants are instructed to book their own lodging.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced upcoming edition: 19–21 May 2027, Nyon, Switzerland; theme: Viticulture 2030: Addressing Environmental, Social and Human Challenges. Agroscope publishes activity dates 19.05.2027–21.05.2027, 08:30–18:00 and registration opening 1 December 2026 at 00:01. These are event dates, not article dates. Within the requested horizon. No official 2028 edition announcement was located; do not assume a Swiss return.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied YOTEL specification: geographically relevant Nyon/La Côte delegate lodging, not downtown-Geneva overflow. Most plausible product is optional short-stay accommodation for delegates, speakers or organizer teams, subject to permission and workable transfers. No evidence supports the seed relocation/extended-stay segment. Historical 2026 attendance was 97 participants, not a 2027 forecast or room count. That historical scale is not inherently too large for the supplied hotel meeting capacity, but 2027 meetings are already assigned to Changins. There is no proven meeting-space relocation or room requirement; do not convert 97 attendees into rooms or claim 20–120 rooms, the whole 237-room hotel, or a resort retreat.
findings.venueCommitments: Published meeting venue: Changins / Haute école de viticulture et œnologie, Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland, within the Nyon / La Côte target territory, not Geneva city or Lausanne. Changins currently publishes Route de Duillier 52, CH-1260 Nyon as its contact address; the 2027 announcement does not specify an auditorium or room. Changins and Agroscope are announced hosts. This is a published campus commitment, not proof of a signed venue contract and not a competing hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified recent timeline: 30 May–1 June 2022 online, replacing planned Japan meetings; 11–15 May 2023 Kyoto, Yamanashi/Kofu and Niigata, Japan; 14–15 May 2024 Asti, Italy; 22–23 May 2025 Vienna, Austria; 20–22 May 2026 Porto, Portugal; 19–21 May 2027 Nyon, Switzerland announced. The owner explicitly describes annual Symposium/General Assembly activity. International partner rotation is verified; annual Nyon demand is not.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific individual self-booking, not an open RFP. The only hotel named in the reviewed 2027 official accommodation instructions is Hôtel B&B NYON, 20 Allée de la Petite Prairie, 1260 Nyon, using corporate code NOVITI27. Owner quote: "OENOVITI Members will need to make their own accommodation bookings" and "Activities will depart and return to this location." Agroscope adds: "You are, of course, free to choose alternative accommodation to suit your needs." Thus an incumbent recommended hotel and activity hub are established, but no exclusive lodging contract, guaranteed room block, allocation size, official housing bureau or hotel RFP is published in these instructions.
findings.organizationStructure: OENOVITI is an international academic/research/industry network, not evidenced as a corporate event agency, PCO or DMC. Its Bordeaux/ISVV coordination office is explicitly the main contact for event organization; an executive committee oversees network operations. ADERA manages network finances and supports project management, not evidenced as a housing bureau. The 2027 local hosts/co-organizers are Changins and Agroscope. Separate network owner/coordinator, campus hosts and self-booking delegates; no external PCO/DMC is identified in the reviewed edition instructions.
findings.competitiveLimitations: B&B HOTEL Nyon has an edition-specific corporate code, proximity recommendation and departure/return hub advantage. These are concrete competitive barriers, not proof of exclusive inventory commitment. No published sold-out notice, overflow requirement, block quantity, rate, cutoff or room-night total was located. Historical 2026 Ipanema Park Hotel was a tour departure point and Quinta do Paço Hotel Rural a dinner venue; neither establishes 2027 lodging business or even a historical accommodation block.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Agathe Lairy via the published OENOVITI team address oenoviti@u-bordeaux.fr, with Pierre-Louis Teissedre as senior referral if needed. Before the published 1 December 2026 registration opening, ask for the named 2027 local logistics lead and whether an optional YOTEL accommodation offer may be shared alongside B&B Nyon. Verify expected overnight delegates, stay dates, any reserved B&B allocation/cutoff and whether transfers can connect YOTEL to Changins and the B&B activity hub. Offer a small, non-exclusive, demand-led arrangement only after those answers; do not send a speculative full-house or meeting-relocation bid.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 is the current sales target, still upcoming as of 16 November 2026; registration opens 1 December 2026. Alternative accommodation is explicitly allowed, so access is conditional rather than closed, but centrally sourced hotel demand is not established. Existing activity logistics favour B&B Nyon. No YOTEL transfer arrangement or access to delegate booking communications is evidenced.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize a modest alternative-accommodation relationship for 2027 and future Changins/Agroscope-hosted workshops if separately identified. The series rotates internationally: annual recurrence is not an annual Nyon lodging opportunity. No published 2028 dates, city or venue were located. Do not market a speculative 2028 Swiss edition or displace the already-announced 2027 campus meeting venue.
